text_asr: MING PAO TORONTO THE COVID VACCINE. AND WHAT'S WORSE, NOT ONLY DOES THE VACCINE APPEAR TO BE USELESS AGAINST THE VIRUS, BUT PEOPLE WHO DO GET INJECTED SEEM TO BE MUCH, MUCH WORSE OFF THAN THOSE WHO REMAIN UNVACCINATED. THIS IS OFFICIAL DATA FROM THE UK GOVERNMENT, WHICH RECORDED DEATHS FROM COVID BETWEEN AUGUST 16TH AND DECEMBER 5TH, A 16-WEEK PERIOD. NOW JUST TAKE A LOOK AT THIS GRAPH, AS REPORTED BY THE DAILY EXPOSÉ, WHICH SHOWS 286% MORE DEATHS FROM COVID AMONG THE VACCINATED THAN THE UNVACCINATED. ANY MARGIN OF ERROR, AND IF THIS DATA IS ACCURATE, WOULD SUGGEST THAT GETTING THE VACCINE MEANS YOU'RE MUCH MORE LIKELY TO DIE FROM COVID THAN IF YOU DON'T GET VACCINATED. BUT WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU DON'T DIE? WELL, ACCORDING TO THE U.S. GOVERNMENT'S OWN DATA, REPORTED BY HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, OVER 100,000 PEOPLE HAVE REQUIRED HOSPITALIZATIONS AFTER GETTING THE VACCINE. AND THESE AREN'T JUST NAMELESS FIGURES ON A PAGE, THEY'RE REAL PEOPLE. LIKE ANGELIA DASEL OF LOUISIANA, A MOTHER WHO HAD NO PRIOR CONDITIONS BEFORE SHE GOT THE VACCINE. THIS IS HER TODAY. SHE CAN BARELY STAND UP AND IS RIDDLED WITH NEUROLOGICAL TREMORS, WHICH DOCTORS SAY IS DIRECTLY CAUSED BY THE VACCINE. IT'S THE SAME STORY FOR SEAN SKELTON OF INDIANA, A MOTHER WITH NO PRIOR CONDITIONS WHO HAS BEEN DEBILITATED AFTER GETTING Pfizer'S INJECTION. IT WAS EVEN WORSE FOR JIMINE NATCHI OF MINNESOTA, WHO GOT FULLY VACCINATED, GOT COVID ANYWAY, AND THEN HAD TO WATCH IN HORROR AS DOCTORS AMPUTATED BOTH OF HER LEGS AND THEN BOTH OF HER HANDS AS WELL.

text_asr: AND THEN THERE'S MATTY DAGARRE, THE 13-YEAR-OLD GIRL FROM OHIO WHO IS NOW PARALYZED FROM THE WAIST DOWN, NEEDS A FEEDING TUBE, AND CAN'T CONTROL HER OWN BODILY FUNCTIONS. AND WE'RE NOT TALKING ABOUT JUST A FEW CASES HERE AND THERE. IN VIETNAM, THE LOCAL CDC HAS HALTED THE USE OF A BATCH OF Pfizer'S VACCINES AFTER MORE THAN 120 CHILDREN HAD TO BE HOSPITALIZED FOR SEVERE REACTIONS TO THE INJECTIONS. THESE CHILDREN EXPERIENCED SYMPTOMS LIKE NAUSEA, HIGH FEVER, AS WELL AS DIFFICULTY EVEN BREATHING. AND IN ANOTHER NEARBY DISTRICT, THREE CHILDREN EVEN DIED AFTER GETTING THE VACCINE. BUT FOR A LOT OF PEOPLE, THE SIDE EFFECTS FROM THE VACCINE SIMPLY MEAN DEATH. PEOPLE LIKE 13-YEAR-OLD BOY FROM MICHIGAN, JACOB CLINIC, WHO DIED IN HIS SLEEP SHORTLY AFTER GETTING HIS SECOND DOSE OF THE Pfizer VACCINE. OR AN 11-YEAR-OLD GIRL FROM GEORGIA, WHO DIED IN SEPTEMBER NOT LONG AFTER GETTING HER Pfizer VACCINATION. AND THEN THERE WAS A 5-YEAR-OLD GIRL WHO DIED JUST FOUR DAYS AFTER GETTING HER FIRST DOSE OF Pfizer IN NOVEMBER. OR HOW ABOUT THIS 8-YEAR-OLD GIRL WHO DIED AFTER HAVING A STROKE AND HEMORRAGING IN HER BRAIN JUST SEVEN DAYS AFTER GETTING HER Pfizer INJECTION. THESE AREN'T ELDERLY PEOPLE WITH SEVERE COMORBIDITIES, OVERWEIGHT AND UNHELTHY. THESE ARE CHILDREN IN PEAK HEALTH WITH NO CONDITIONS AND WITH NO RISK FROM COVID. AND THEY'RE DROPPING DEAD AFTER GETTING THE VACCINE. IF IT WERE ONE OR TWO PEOPLE HAVING THESE REACTIONS, WE COULD CHALK IT UP TO RANDOM ANOMALIES THAT YOU SEE WITH ANY VACCINE. BUT WE'RE TALKING ABOUT 946,000 PEOPLE. AND FOR EACH OF THE PARENTS WHO HAD TO WATCH THEIR PERFECTLY HEALTHY CHILD DIE AFTER GETTING INJECTED WITH AN EXPERIMENTAL DRUG, THESE AREN'T JUST MEANINGLESS NUMBERS ON A PAGE. WE'RE WITNESSING THE CONSEQUENCES OF THIS UNTESTED, UNPROVEN, RUSHED VACCINE FIRSTHAND, AND IT'S FAR WORSE THAN ANYONE FEARED. AND THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING. UNLESS AMERICANS AND PARENTS STAND UP TO THESE UNSCIENTIFIC MANDATES, WE COULD BE LOOKING AT HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS MORE DEAD AND PERMANENTLY INJURED VICTIMS FROM THE BIGGEST EXPERIMENT

text_asr: ON HUMAN BEINGS IN HISTORY. FOR ONE AMERICAN NEWS, I'M PEARSON SHARP. THE SUPREME COURT HAS JUST ISSUED TWO RULINGS ON ONE OF THE PRESIDENT'S MORE CONTROVERSIAL MEASURES TO BATTLE COVID, VACCINE MANDATES FOR PRIVATE EMPLOYERS. THE SUPREME COURT BLOCKING SOME OF THE RULES PUT IN PLACE BY THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION. LET'S GO TO NBC NEWS JUSTICE CORRESPONDENT PETE WILLIAMS, WHO CAN TELL US MORE. PETE. SO, LESTER, BY A VOTE OF 6 TO 3, THE SUPREME COURT IS BLOCKING THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION FROM CARRYING OUT THE RULES IMPOSED BY OSHA, THE OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ADMINISTRATION THAT WOULD REQUIRE COMPANIES THAT EMPLOY MORE THAN 100 WORKERS TO MAKE SURE THAT ALL THEIR EMPLOYEES EITHER GET VACCINATED FOR COVID OR WEAR MASKS AND BE TESTED ONCE A WEEK. THE COURT SAID THE LAW THAT ALLOWS OSHA TO DO WHAT IT DOES EMPOWERS IT TO SET WORKPLACE SAFETY STANDARDS BUT NOT BROAD PUBLIC HEALTH MEASURES. THE GOVERNMENT SIMPLY DIDN'T HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO DO THIS, THE COURT SAID, SO IT'S PUTTING IT ON HOLD WHILE THE CASE IS GOING TO PLAY OUT IN THE LOWER COURTS ON THE BROADER QUESTION OF THE GOVERNMENT'S AUTHORITY HERE. BUT IN A SEPARATE RULING, BY A VOTE OF 5 TO 4, THE SUPREME COURT HAS SAID THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION CAN ENFORCE THE SEPARATE RULE THAT APPLIES TO ABOUT 10,000 HEALTH CARE WORKERS OR 20,000 TO 20,000, I'M SORRY, 20 MILLION HEALTH CARE WORKERS IN THE U.S. WHO TREAT MEDICARE OR MEDICAID PATIENTS. THE COURT SAID THAT THAT AUTHORITY IS WELL WITHIN THE POWER OF THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES TO SET THE STANDARDS FOR PATIENT CARE. THE FOUR DISSENTERS IN THAT CASE WERE THE COURT'S MORE CONSERVATIVE MEMBERS, GORSUCH, BARRETT, ALITO AND THOMAS. THE THREE DISSENTERS IN THE OSHA CASE WERE THE COURT'S THREE LIBERALS, BRIER, SOTOMAYOR AND KAGAN. SO THIS BLOCKS THE ENFORCEMENT OF THE OSHA RULE BUT ALLOWS THE ENFORCEMENT OF THE HHS RULE.
